title: Interface Specification: the system-power-controller supervisor interface

standards_mappings.rationale: Backs SWE.2 with a real interface specification: providing and consuming module, the real C signature transcribed from the header at 308028fb, per-parameter direction, unit, meaning and valid range with the mechanism that enforces it, a return contract whose values are the enumerators the source defines, validity signalling read off the real error paths, timing where the source imposes one, concurrency, and a required not_specified_by_source list. Three elements over the SBC supervisor, a multi-instance state machine with a void watchdog-driving trigger. The status stays partially_mapped: the whole family remains a reconstruction of an existing implementation rather than the product of an architectural design activity, and Component Design remains absent.

providing_module.name: SBC driver, the system power controller
providing_module.role: Supervises the SBC device that arbitrates the high-voltage contactor and precharge sequence, and drives its periodic watchdog so the device does not time out. It is a state machine driven by requests from the application and advanced by a 10 ms trigger.

consuming_modules.name: The 10 ms cyclic task
consuming_modules.consumption_evidence: SBC_Trigger(&sbc_stateMcuSupervisor) is called from FTSK_RunUserCodeCyclic10ms at src/app/task/config/ftask_cfg.c L269, in the same function as ADC_Control at L264 and SPS_Ctrl at L265. The header names the 10 ms task at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.h L70 and the cycle context is defined as 10u at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.h L78.

parameters.name: pInstance
parameters.meaning: Which SBC instance to advance. The driver is written as a multi-instance state machine, and this pointer selects the one.

values.(no return value): The function returns nothing; it advances the state machine and may refresh the device watchdog.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: A void periodic entry point for a device whose watchdog is safety-relevant gives the caller no way to learn whether the watchdog was refreshed or the state machine advanced.
return_contract.evidence: src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.h L215 declares void; src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L267 is the definition.

validity_signalling.mechanism: No return value. The re-entrance guard and the timer guard both return early without effect and without signalling.
validity_signalling.evidence: The re-entrance guard returns at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L273-L274 and the timer guard at L286; neither reports the skip.

timing.evidence: Driven every 10 ms: the cycle context is defined as 10u at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.h L78, checked against FTSK_TASK_CYCLIC_10MS_CYCLE_TIME at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.h L80, and the caller is FTSK_RunUserCodeCyclic10ms at src/app/task/config/ftask_cfg.c L269.

timeouts.name: SBC_WINDOW_WATCHDOG_PERIOD_MS
timeouts.meaning: The period within which the device watchdog must be refreshed.
timeouts.evidence: The macro is defined at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.h L105 and the periodic refresh is driven from SBC_Trigger at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L277-L280.

timeouts.name: SBC_STATEMACHINE_LONGTIME
timeouts.meaning: The longest state dwell, expressed in trigger calls rather than in time.
timeouts.evidence: The macro is defined at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.h L100 and the down-counting timer is at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L283-L286.

concurrency.evidence: Called from the 10 ms cyclic task. The re-entrance and timer guards are inside the function, and the request write in SBC_SetStateRequest is inside a task critical section.
concurrency.protection_mechanism: re-entrance flag and a down-counting timer

error_paths.observed_behaviour: Returns immediately without advancing the state machine.

error_paths.condition: the state timer has not elapsed
error_paths.observed_behaviour: Decrements the timer and returns without handling the state machine this cycle.

not_specified_by_source: The interface does not state whether the device watchdog was refreshed on this call, even though refreshing it is the safety-relevant effect and the return value is void.
The re-entrance and timer guards skip silently, so a persistently deferred supervisor is not observable through this interface.
The header does not state which device the watchdog refresh reaches, only that it happens if the watchdog state is activated, at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L278.

elements.consuming_module: Application code that requests an SBC state

parameters.name: pInstance
parameters.meaning: Which SBC instance to request the state of.
parameters.range_evidence: FAS_ASSERT(pInstance != NULL_PTR) at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L246 and L268.

parameters.name: stateRequest
parameters.meaning: Which state to move the supervisor to.
parameters.valid_range: A member of SBC_STATE_REQUEST_e; legality is decided by SBC_CheckStateRequest, whose verdict is returned rather than asserted.
parameters.range_evidence: Checked by SBC_CheckStateRequest at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L251; the request is only recorded when the check returns SBC_OK at L253-L255.

values.SBC_OK: The request was legal and has been recorded.
values.SBC_ILLEGAL_REQUEST: The request is not permitted in the current state and is discarded.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: A genuine refusal channel: the default is SBC_ILLEGAL_REQUEST and the request is only written on SBC_OK, so a caller can tell that a request was refused.
return_contract.evidence: retVal is initialised to SBC_ILLEGAL_REQUEST at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L248, overwritten by the check at L251, and returned at L258; the enumerators are declared at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.h L108-L126.

validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value SBC_RETURN_TYPE_e. The request is recorded inside a task critical section and only on SBC_OK, so acceptance and recording are atomic with respect to another task.
validity_signalling.evidence: src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L250-L256 wraps the check and the write in OS_EnterTaskCritical and OS_ExitTaskCritical; the return at L258 reflects the same check.

timing.evidence: Not periodic; recorded immediately and acted on by the 10 ms SBC_Trigger cycle.

concurrency.evidence: Called from a task. The check and the write are inside a task critical section, so a concurrent request cannot interleave.
concurrency.protection_mechanism: OS_EnterTaskCritical / OS_ExitTaskCritical around the check and the write

error_paths.condition: the request is illegal in the current state
error_paths.observed_behaviour: Returns SBC_ILLEGAL_REQUEST and does not record the request.
error_paths.evidence: src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L248, L253-L255 and the return at L258.

not_specified_by_source: The interface does not say what happens to a request that is legal now but whose target state has moved on by the time the 10 ms cycle runs.
The enumerator set is not documented per value in the header, so a caller cannot be sure which value a particular misuse produces beyond the two named here.
The interface does not state whether a request that is refused is remembered or discarded; the source discards it at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L253-L255.

values.(state enumerators): The current state of the named supervisor instance, one of the SBC_STATEMACHINE_e values declared at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.h L137-L144.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: A state read with no separate failure value; the enumerator set includes error states, so a fault is visible when the supervisor is in one.
return_contract.evidence: The value is read directly from pInstance->state at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L264.

validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value only, but the enumerator set includes error states, so a stuck or faulted supervisor is visible to a caller that reads the state.
validity_signalling.evidence: src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L261-L265 returns pInstance->state; the enumerators including the error states are at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.h L114-L146.

timing.evidence: A read of instance state; no period.

concurrency.evidence: A plain read of a field with no lock, while the write on IFSE-001502 is inside a task critical section; the interface does not describe an atomic relationship between them.

not_specified_by_source: The read is unguarded while the corresponding write is critical-sectioned, so the interface does not state whether a read can observe a half-updated state.
The interface does not state when the state was last updated relative to the 10 ms cycle.
Because the driver is multi-instance, the interface gives no default instance; a caller that passes the wrong pointer gets the wrong supervisor's state with no error.

interface_level_gaps.gap: The interface that drives the device watchdog is void, and the watchdog is the safety-relevant effect of that call.
interface_level_gaps.consequence: A caller cannot learn whether the watchdog was refreshed. If the refresh were to fail silently, the device would time out and this interface would be the place a caller would look for evidence, and there is none.
interface_level_gaps.evidence: SBC_Trigger is void at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.h L215 and the periodic watchdog refresh is driven from inside it at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L277-L280, with its return value discarded with an explicit cast at L280.

interface_level_gaps.gap: The state read is not protected by the same critical section as the state write.
interface_level_gaps.consequence: The interface does not state whether a read concurrent with a request can observe a partially updated instance.
interface_level_gaps.evidence: The write is wrapped at src/app/driver/sbc/sbc.c L250-L256 and the read at L261-L265 is a bare field access.

revision_history.description: Three elements over the SBC supervisor boundary, read from sbc.h and sbc.c at 308028fb. The SBC is the component that arbitrates the high-voltage contactor and precharge sequence, so this boundary carries safety weight; the record notes that the instance pointer is the parameter that makes it multi-instance and that the watchdog is driven from the 10 ms cycle.
